native_scores: Read the original F scores.jsonl and align with normalized case_id/repetition identities; do not replace the scorer. Replay only a copy of the sealed raw run so original artifacts remain unchanged.
aggregation: positive micro means of original top1/ndcg10; optional recall/MRR/span scores with explicit available/unavailable denominators
equal-repository and equal-category macro means; source-target and query-language strata
paired zh-minus-en family means; never treat paired translations as independent families
original no_answer_correct plus returned status, separate from positive metrics
source evidence valid/invalid/unverified counts and all protocol statuses
predeclared hard-negative overlap observations, separating hits overlapping only negatives from hits also overlapping positive evidence; no new scorer/gate
facets remain static reviewed annotations; native answer-group and span scores are reported without claiming automatic semantic facet grading

interval_plan.method: resample whole bilingual families within each repository, retain both variants; percentile 2.5/97.5 interval; also show equal-repo cluster resampling and conservative source-file component counts
interval_plan.limitations: Only two repositories and seven source-file-linked components. These are conditional descriptive intervals, not evidence of independent 32-family population sampling, cross-repository generalization or semantic capability gain.

quality_gate: Preserve actual F gates and failures; no new passing threshold, relabel or score-guided retries.
